meta.name: campaign-analytics
meta.description: Analyzes campaign performance with multi-touch attribution, funnel conversion analysis, and ROI calculation for marketing optimization. Use when analyzing marketing campaigns, ad performance, attribution models, conversion rates, or calculating marketing ROI, ROAS, CPA, and campaign metrics across channels.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析营销活动效果，计算归因与ROI
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要评估多渠道营销活动的投入产出比。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze campaign performance with attribution and ROI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to evaluate ROI across multiple marketing channels.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以分析营销活动数据，包括多渠道归因、漏斗转化和 ROI 计算。它会读取你提供的 JSON 数据，并输出归因模型结果、漏斗瓶颈和 ROI 指标。
howto.when: 当你需要分析营销活动效果、广告表现、归因模型、转化率或计算 ROI、ROAS、CPA 等指标时触发。

say.text: 分析我的营销活动数据，使用时间衰减归因模型。
帮我看看这个漏斗数据，找出转化瓶颈。
计算这些广告活动的 ROI 和 ROAS。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze campaign performance data, including multi-touch attribution, funnel conversion, and ROI calculation. It reads your JSON data and outputs attribution model results, funnel bottlenecks, and ROI metrics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to analyze marketing campaign performance, ad performance, attribution models, conversion rates, or calculate ROI, ROAS, CPA, and other campaign metrics.

say_en.text: Analyze my campaign data using the time-decay attribution model.
say_en.note: Claude runs attribution_analyzer.py and outputs attribution results.

say_en.text: Check this funnel data and identify conversion bottlenecks.
Calculate ROI and ROAS for these ad campaigns.
say_en.note: Claude runs campaign_roi_calculator.py and outputs ROI metrics.
